# Rayon

> AI-powered CAD software designed for interior designers and architects to create floor plans, technical drawings, and mood boards with built-in collaboration and asset libraries.

Rayon is a modern design tool that combines artificial intelligence with CAD capabilities, offering flexible pricing tiers and support for professional workflows across interior design, architecture, and real estate. The platform integrates with industry-standard formats like DWG and PDF while providing curated furniture libraries from brands like IKEA, Knoll, and Kartell.

## Key Topics
